annotation.title_clean: Il-Kummissjoni tippubblika linji gwida dwar id-definizzjoni tas-sistema tal-IA biex tiffaċilita l-applikazzjoni tar-regoli tal-ewwel Att dwar l-IA
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on the AI system definition to facilitate the application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG Communications Networks, Content and Technology
annotation.summary_en: Maltese-language Commission web page announcing publication, on 6 February 2025, of non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the EU AI Act, issued alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It lists downloadable language versions and notes that the first AI Act rules began applying on 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines explain the practical application of the AI system definition in the AI Act
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated based on practical experience
Published together with guidelines on prohibited AI practices
First AI Act rules (definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025
AI Act classifies AI systems into risk categories
